edits.before: Q a vital and back out — free chip he cannot answer. Identify how Renekton contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: He has no fury at level 1, so there is no empowered stun to parry — trade autos at Lunge range and save your Riposte.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Chain Lunges off Vital procs while his Slice-W-Q is down — Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1 and 8s only at rank 5, so early trades are yours.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Riposte it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ruthless Predator: 16s at rank 1 — empowered it stuns 1.5s and shreds shields. Parry it and it returns as a stun on him. - Cull the Meek is 7s and heals him: bring Grievous Wounds. - Slice and Dice: 16s dash.

notes: The empowered-W shield-break (Riot's text: 'destroying damage shields on the target') was nowhere on the page and now appears in breakdown.cooldowns. The packet defect 'never names any of Renekton's abilities' is partly stale — Ruthless Predator is named throughout — but Cull the Meek, Slice and Dice, Reign of Anger and Dominus genuinely never appeared; two of them do now.
